title: What is new (4.60 to 4.78)
text: 4.78: new players start with one Multiverse Wiki book (setting starter.starterWiki, on). 4.77: /multiverse sin purge. 4.76: the 26 canon devils polished. 4.75: arm straps on every shield. 4.74: the six hero katanas rebuilt as true katanas. 4.73: real arrows with magic hits, real falling meteors, longer technique durations (durationScale 2.0). 4.72: bigger bows in the hand. 4.71: the hero Shield blocks and reflects like a real shield, techniques work on any target, wings are drawn on the back, Devil Awakening with mastery, canon devil looks. 4.70: fourteen weapons lose the shared gold-and-navy look. 4.69 and 4.62: the Multiverse Hub gets the Codex inside it, custom icons and a smaller window. 4.63 and 4.56: the Weapon page shows upgrade options and many mastery bars. 4.62: bosses take no damage from effects nobody cast. 4.60 and 4.61: bows and katanas redone. The Multiverse Hub (key F7, or the Multiverse status key) has replaced the old Codex book: eight tabs (Status, Weapons, Skills, Quests, Attunement, Multiverse, Codex, Settings), and this wiki is inside its Codex tab. ui.hub = false in nusmp-ui-client.toml brings the old book back.
